_metadata.description: Liveness probing & classification: internal local-port probes, external public-URL probes, scheduled probe history, and failure classification.

requirements.title: Probe each exposed route's local port (internal liveness)
requirements.description: An internal probe issues an HTTP request to each exposed route's local port + health_path and records whether the scenario is listening, with latency and any error.

requirements.title: Probe each exposed route via its public URL (external liveness)
requirements.description: An external probe issues an HTTP request to each exposed route's public_url to verify end-to-end connectivity through the tunnel, recording status, latency, and error.

requirements.title: Persist probe history per route and kind
requirements.description: Each probe result (route, kind internal|external, status, latency, error) is written to the probes table on a schedule so history can be queried for trends and SLA.

requirements.title: Classify failures from current probe signals
requirements.description: Combining internal/external probe pairs, the classifier produces healthy, tunnel-down, scenario-down, and config-drift outcomes that drive current recovery/operator guidance.

requirements.title: Isolate DNS failures and Cloudflare outages
requirements.description: Add resolver-specific and upstream/Cloudflare-status signals so the classifier can distinguish dns-failure and cloudflare-outage from generic external probe failure.
